submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / identity-preserve.
Create ONE new independently painted native HD transparent RGBA animation sprite, square at least 1024px. ICE SWORD GIRL running NORTHEAST, rear three-quarter view facing diagonally away toward upper RIGHT. Image1 defines her exact northeast camera and identity; image2 approved bamboo girl defines this initial running pose ONLY, not identity, outfit, bow, colors, or proportions; image3 defines her old northeast boot appearance and correct heading only, not its old tiny resolution or static body; image4 definitive original identity; image5 approved polished bright painted game style.
New frame NE01: LEFT far leg extended to ground behind/under hip, LEFT boot weight just accepted with flat sole; RIGHT near knee bent with heel recovering high behind, underside of right boot seen. Near RIGHT shoulder has the one ice sword hand moving FORWARD, elbow bent, sword can point upper right clear of face. Far LEFT hand holds one blue talisman and swings BACK to lower left. Visible short connected thigh-knee-ankle chains; thigh depth should follow rear three-quarter camera. Shoe heel-to-toe direction matches northeast travel in this perspective, do not turn toes laterally outward. Foot sole exposure is from knee flexion, not twisted sideways ankle.
Preserve image1 high brown bun, long dark hair, silver/ice-blue ornaments and blue tassels, white-blue-gold short robe, sash, white boots with blue soles. Short rounded chibi limbs, huge chibi head. Show only thin right cheek as in image1, no frontal eye. Bright polished painted detail, clean real alpha edge. Fixed full canvas: crown about7%, virtual support ground about95%, head and body centered as image1 with room for sword at screenright, stable size for future frames. Natural torso lean, no whole-character tilt or moving whole figure to ground. Exactly two arms, two legs, one sword in anatomical RIGHT near hand and one talisman in anatomical LEFT far hand. No bow/quiver/green outfit, effects, shadow, background, text, grid, contact line, sprite sheet, duplicates or direct enlargement of the old512.
